examples.zh: 士兵们向城内移动 试图在夜幕降临前夺取城池

examples.zh: 保姆抓着小孩用湿毛巾遮住他 动作很快

senses.zh: 提供激励行动的手段;

examples.en: This moved me to sacrifice my career
examples.zh: 这让我感动,为了牺牲事业

senses.en: arouse sympathy or compassion in

examples.en: Her fate moved us all
examples.zh: 她的命运让我们所有人感动

senses.en: dispose of by selling
senses.zh: 通过出售处置

examples.en: The chairman of the company told the salesmen to move the computers

examples.en: run through your presentation before the meeting

senses.en: live one's life in a specified environment

senses.en: have a turn; make one's move in a game

examples.en: Can I go now?
examples.zh: 我现在可以走了吗?

senses.en: propose formally; in a debate or parliamentary meeting
